```dafny
method unique(l: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires l != []
    ensures result == DistinctSorted(l)

method DistinctSorted(l: seq<int>) returns (r: seq<int>)
    ensures r == [x | x in l, x is unique] && IsSorted(r)

predicate IsSorted(s: seq<int>)
    ensures |s| <= 1 || (forall i :: 0 <= i < |s| - 1 ==> s[i] <= s[i + 1])
    
predicate Distinct(s: seq<int>)
    ensures forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |s| ==> s[i] != s[j]
```
